newsitem.title: UK: Blenheim leaps on renewed takeover hopes.
newsitem.headline: Blenheim leaps on renewed takeover hopes.

text.p: Shares in Blenheim Group Plc leapt in early trading on Tuesday amid the latest outbreak of speculation that the exhibition organiser will receive a takeover bid.
The stock was up 49-1/2p at 485 by 0730 GMT, after touching a record 500p -- surpassing the previous high of 470p set in an earlier bout of bid speculation in June.
The current outbreak of bid excitement follows a report in Monday's Independent newspaper that Reed-Elsever was preparing a bid of about 480p a share.
Reed shares were down 3-1/2p at 11.79-1/2 stg.
A report in the Daily Mail newspaper on Tuesday said that there was speculation about a 480p-per-share bid could arrive today.
No-one at Blenheim or Reed was immediately available for comment.
